decisions.reason: Danish style naming is owned by the separate naming-convention Requirement and does not change the catalog's source system or coverage.

The client accepts the immediately preceding proposal that the document default to English while style names are Danish, changing the prior Danish document-language requirement and resolving its value conflict.

Style-name language does not change bullet sizing, appearance, alignment, or scaling behavior.
The naming-language decision does not modify the required legacy-content paste behavior, stability constraint, or test files.
Danish style names do not change the required containment of pasted tables or right-hand columns.
The style-name language does not alter the requirement for reliable manual line breaks after pasting.
The naming-language decision does not change the supported Word environment or the general reliability and multi-user stability requirements.
